items.html: *And let us return to the intent. We say that AVI were initially face to face, since Mochin were made for them from Keter, as above. However, their MAN, the cause that established and sustained the aspect of face to face, was the existence of these seven kings, who were in the womb of Bina, and these were her MAN. For it is always so, that the sons are the MAN of Ima. And while these seven kings were within Bina, they raised MAN and caused a coupling for AVI, and Mochin were drawn to them, and AVI were restored to face to face, and they coupled together in order to bring forth these seven kings. And at the time these kings came out, had they not died but rather remained in existence, they would have sustained AVI in face to face even after they came out below, and they would have been useful for their MAN. However, since they broke and died, therefore AVI too — their posterior, which sustained them face to face, descended downward, and then they returned to back to back, since there was no longer anyone to raise MAN for them and sustain their return to face to face.
